snapshot_note: Snapshot for tests and as a starting point. SubmitReady re-reads the live guidelines on every run.

sources.name: Breast Cancer Research and Treatment: Submission guidelines

csl_style.title: Breast Cancer Research and Treatment
csl_style.note: Dependent style; its parent is springer-basic-brackets (numbers in square brackets).

requirements.rule: Main text at most 3,500 words (not counting abstract, title page, tables, figures, references)
requirements.quote: The length of submitted papers should not exceed 3500 words.

requirements.rule: Suggest at least three reviewers without conflict of interest in the cover letter, with academic e-mail addresses
requirements.quote: Note: Authors must suggest at least three possible reviewers without conflict of interest in the Cover Letter upon submission.

requirements.rule: Tumor marker studies must follow the REMARK reporting recommendations, or the paper is returned without review
requirements.quote: Failure to do so will result in the manuscript being returned to the author without peer review

requirements.rule: Papers whose data all come from a single cell line are generally not accepted
requirements.quote: In general, Breast Cancer Research and Treatment will not accept for publication papers in which all of the data shown in the paper were obtained using a single cell line.

requirements.rule: Upload editable source files (.docx or LaTeX) at every submission and revision
requirements.quote: For your manuscript text please always submit in common word processing formats such as .docx or LaTeX.

requirements.rule: Corresponding author must give an ORCID before submission
requirements.quote: This publication requires that the corresponding author provides his/her ORCiD ID before proceeding with submission.

requirements.rule: Abstract of 150 to 250 words
requirements.quote: Please provide a structured abstract of 150 to 250 words which should be divided into the following sections:

requirements.rule: Structured abstract headed Purpose, Methods, Results, Conclusion
requirements.quote: Purpose (stating the main purposes and research question)

requirements.rule: 4 to 6 keywords
requirements.quote: Please provide 4 to 6 keywords which can be used for indexing purposes.

requirements.rule: Manuscript in Word. The page also says "Save your file in doc format. Do not submit docx files." That line sits in the note on Word 2007 equations; the source files rule names .docx as accepted
requirements.quote: Manuscripts should be submitted in Word.

requirements.rule: Normal, plain font such as 10-point Times Roman (an example, not a rule)
requirements.quote: Use a normal, plain font (e.g., 10-point Times Roman) for text.

requirements.rule: Number the pages with the automatic page numbering function
requirements.quote: Use the automatic page numbering function to number the pages.

requirements.rule: No field functions. Live reference-manager citations are field codes: convert them to plain text only in the final copy you upload
requirements.quote: Do not use field functions.

requirements.rule: No more than three levels of headings
requirements.quote: Please use no more than three levels of displayed headings.

requirements.rule: Acknowledgments in a separate section before the reference list
requirements.quote: Acknowledgments of people, grants, funds, etc. should be placed in a separate section before the reference list.

requirements.rule: DOIs as full links in the reference list
requirements.quote: If available, please always include DOIs as full DOI links in your reference list (e.g. “https://doi.org/abc”).

requirements.rule: A 'Statements and Declarations' section
requirements.quote: The following statements must be included in your submitted manuscript under the heading 'Statements and Declarations'.

requirements.rule: 'Statements and Declarations' placed after the References
requirements.quote: This should be placed after the References section.

requirements.rule: A Data Availability Statement (under Statements and Declarations)
requirements.quote: All original research must include a Data Availability Statement.

requirements.rule: Author contributions statement (encouraged)
requirements.quote: Authors are encouraged to include a statement that specifies the contribution of every author to the research and preparation of the manuscript.

requirements.rule: Document any LLM use in the Methods section
requirements.quote: Use of an LLM should be properly documented in the Methods section

requirements.rule: Tables made with the table function, not spreadsheets
requirements.quote: Use the table function, not spreadsheets, to make tables.

requirements.rule: Figure files: EPS for vector, TIFF for halftones (MS Office also accepted); halftones at least 300 dpi, combination art 600 dpi, line art 1200 dpi; named Fig1, Fig2
requirements.quote: Halftones should have a minimum resolution of 300 dpi.

requirements.rule: Figure captions start with bold 'Fig.' and the number, with no punctuation after the number or at the end
requirements.quote: Figure captions begin with the term Fig. in bold type, followed by the figure number, also in bold type.

requirements.rule: No punctuation after the figure number or at the end of the caption
requirements.quote: No punctuation is to be included after the number, nor is any punctuation to be placed at the end of the caption.

requirements.rule: Figure lettering in Helvetica or Arial, 8 to 12 pt; no titles or captions inside figures
requirements.quote: To add lettering, it is best to use Helvetica or Arial (sans serif fonts).

requirements.rule: Cite supplementary files as 'Online Resource' (Online Resource 1, 2, ...)
requirements.quote: Refer to the supplementary files as “Online Resource”, e.g., "... as shown in the animation (Online Resource 3)", “... additional data are given in Online Resource 4”.

requirements.rule: Supplementary files named ESM_1, ESM_2, ...; text as PDF; spreadsheets as .csv or .xlsx
requirements.quote: Name the files consecutively, e.g. “ESM_3.mpg”, “ESM_4.pdf”.

requirements.rule: Each supplementary file holds the article title, journal name, author names and the corresponding author's affiliation and e-mail
requirements.quote: Please include in each file the following information: article title, journal name, author names; affiliation and e-mail address of the corresponding author.
